compiled_state.title: RED test: __main__ pipeline overwrites checks, records source, computes summary, exits non-zero below threshold
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-7: unit tests written and passing (pipeline portion)

## Description
Failing integration tests invoking `python -m plugins.dso.scripts.gov_copy_postprocess <artifact-path>`. Cases: LLM-supplied checks overwritten; checks.source set to 'deterministic-post-processing'; 100%-pass artifact -> exit 0 with closing_threshold_met:true; <95%-pass -> exit non-zero with closing_threshold_met:false; artifact written back to disk.

## Given/When/Then
Given an artifact with one item {text:'Applications are reviewed.', checks:{fk_grade:1,banned_words_found:[],active_voice:true,source:'llm'}}; When CLI runs on it; Then exit code is non-zero, artifact has checks.active_voice==false, checks.source=='deterministic-post-processing', rationale.deviations has rule_id='active_voice', stdout contains 'closing_threshold_met: false'.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh
- [ ] RED test fails
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py -k pipeline 2>&1 | grep -E '(ImportError|ModuleNotFoundError|AssertionError|FileNotFoundError)' || true

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_gov_copy_postprocess.py: Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
